notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with mana value seven or greater.
description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and by sacrificing any creature with mana value seven or greater.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, copying Burnt Offering.
Resolve the copy of Burnt Offering, adding at least {5}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
